facts.fact: The Ministry for the Interior says phase two of the Margins ID Systems contract integrates security and economic IT systems to the new ID database for verification services.

GMB.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
No count or share enrolled is given.
Nothing is stated on a number at birth.

facts.fact: Margins ID Systems Ltd will design, build, co-operate and fund the new ID system for eight years under a build, co-operate and transfer model, sharing revenue 70/30 with the Government, with all assets transferred to the Government at the end.

GMB.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Ministry for the Interior says the first phase of its contract with Margins ID Systems covers mass enrolment of citizens and residents on a new biometric ID system, replacing all valid cards free with ten-year cards.
